Flip: likely resale $420 hammer (Gowans Oct 2025 close comparable), less about 15% auction seller commission ($63) and $0 postage (bulky, pickup only) = $357; $357 / 2.44 = $146.31, rounded down to $145. Rests on a single close sale, so treat as an upper limit.
lots.confidence_reason: Clear identification from two photos (no maker mark expected or seen) and one good close SOLD entry with page and photo checked. Only one close sale, the rest are category guides.

Dropped Gowans 396255 ('WORKSHOP BENCH', $110): photo shows a modern steel-framed bench with backboard, not comparable. lots.key_photo_findings: Leg vise with wooden chop, iron screw and tommy bar plus pegged parallel guide at the left front; full-length tool trough at the back; dog hole in the top; one drawer with turned knob; trestle ends with wedged through-tenon stretchers; heavy wear and grime, no visible cracks to the top in these shots; no maker mark.
lots.condition: Heavily worn and dirty, appears structurally sound from the photos; finish worn, vise appears complete. Underside, top splits and woodworm not visible.
lots.question_for_armitage: What are the length, depth and height? Is the top solid with no big splits or woodworm, does the vise screw turn freely, and does the bench knock down (wedged stretchers) for transport?
